sloka: ततः त्वाम् देवि सुभगे क्षेमेण पुनर् आगता ।यक्ष्ये प्रमुदिता गन्गे सर्व काम समृद्धये ॥२-५२-८५॥
transliteration: tataḥ tvām devi subhage kṣemeṇa punar āgatā ।yakṣye pramuditā gange sarva kāma samṛddhaye ॥2-52-85॥

translations.english: O Ganga, protected by you, this son (Rama) of Dasaratha, the sagacious maharaja, will carry out his father's command. He along with his brother will return after living in the forest for full fourteen years. O fortunate Devi, he will worship you in delight for fulfilling all his desires after his safe return.
